newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end 1.10 pct up before weekend.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end 1.10 pct up before weekend.

text.p: Pakistani stocks ended 1.10 percent higher on Friday on speculative buying of select blue chips, but trading remained dull before the weekend, dealers said.
"Trading was dull today as investors and institutions kept to the sidelines," one dealer said. "Only speculative activity in a few blue chips pushed the index up."
The index rsoe 20.80 points to end at 1,919.07. Losers led gainers 148 to 63. PTCL rose 1.05 rupees to 41.40 and Hub Power 1.95 to 53.25.
